power.neoorigins.kraken_dries_out.descri: Ka heke iho te hau i a koe i waho o te wai: ka roa rawa te haere ki te mata, ka ngenge koe. Ko te ua, ko te kohua wai, ko te Waipū Waipū, ko tētahi aratohu kaha rānei e tata ana, e pupuri katoa ana i a ia.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_summon_guardian: Ka karanga i tētahi kaitiaki kia whawhai mo koe. Max 2 i te wā kotahi. E rima ngā utu o te waikura. 20 hēkona ki muri. Ka whiwhi koe i te whiu kotahi mēnā ka mate i te whawhai.
origins.neoorigins.warden.name: Kaiwhakahaere
origins.neoorigins.warden.description: I whānau mai i te pōuri hohonu  ka ite i te ao mā ngā ngaru, ka tuku i tētahi pupuhi oro i te whānuitanga, ka patu pēnei i te rāmere. He rākau, he mamae hoki i te rā.

power.neoorigins.warden_sonic_boom.descr: Ka pupuhi i tētahi pupuhi oro whakangaro (8 damage magic + Slowness III i roto i te rohe 10-block). E wha ngā utu o te manawanui. 20 hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.warden_echolocation.des: E whiti ana ngā mea ora e tata ana, e kitea ana puta noa i ngā pakitara.
power.neoorigins.warden_tremor_sense.des: E kite ana i ngā mea tawhiti  ia rua hēkona, e whiti ana ngā mea katoa i roto i te 24 poraka mō te toru hēkona.
power.neoorigins.warden_strength.name: Te Mana Pouri Nui

power.neoorigins.warden_hulking_frame.de: 15% nui ake i te kaitākaro noa.

origins.neoorigins.dwarf.name: Ngārara
origins.neoorigins.dwarf.description: He kaitoi whenua pakari  iti, he patu patu, he ngenge i te whakarewa, engari he poto, he puhoi i runga i te mata.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_compact_frame.des: 80% te rahi o tētahi kaitākaro noa  e hāngai ana i roto i ngā wāhi iti ake.

power.neoorigins.dwarf_darkvision.name: Ko te Darkvision
power.neoorigins.dwarf_darkvision.descri: Ka taea te kite mārama i roto i te pōuri katoa  he oranga i raro i te whenua. Whakapā atu ki te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.dwarf_sturdy_legs.name: Ngā waewae pakari
power.neoorigins.dwarf_sturdy_legs.descr: 15% te puhoi o te nekehanga  ngā waewae poto, engari he pūmau.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stonecunning.name: Te mahi kohatu
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stonecunning.desc: He 25% te tere ake o te pakaru o ngā poraka  ngā ringa mahi i runga i tētahi rauemi.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_short_reach.name: Ngā Ringa Poto
power.neoorigins.dwarf_short_reach.descr: Ka whakaitihia te whānuitanga whakawhitiwhitinga poraka e 0.5  ringaringa poto, kaha te hopu.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_mining_hunger.des: Whakamahia 25% iti iho te hiakai i ngā mahi katoa  i hangaia mō te manawanui.
Kua whakawhiwhia ki tētahi pākaha rino iti (Unbreaking II, Efficiency I) ina whiriwhiri koe i tēnei takenga mai.
origins.neoorigins.breeze.name: He hau
origins.neoorigins.breeze.description: He mea hanga o te hau i whānau mai i roto i ngā Whare Whakamātautau  tere, i roto i te hau, me te patu i te hau, engari he māmā, he ngoikore hoki.
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_charge.name: Te utu o te hau
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_charge.desc: Ka whakarewahia he pupuhi hau e whakaheke ana i te hoariri. E rima ngā hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_dash.name: Ko te hau o te hau
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_dash.descri: Ka pupuhi ki mua i te hau. E whā hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.breeze_no_fall_damage.d: Ka taea te huri: ka mau te hau i a koe e hinga ana. I runga i te taunoa  tahuri atu ki te kī pūkenga ki te whenua patu faufaa.
power.neoorigins.breeze_jump_boost.name: Te rerenga ki runga
power.neoorigins.breeze_jump_boost.descr: Ka taea te huri: ka piki ake te peke (Jump Boost II). I runga i te taunoa  tahuri atu ki te kī pūkenga ki te hiahia koe teitei peke noa.
power.neoorigins.breeze_speed_boost.name: Te hau o muri

power.neoorigins.vampire_entity_group.de: Kua whakarārangitia hei undead. Kua whara i te Hauora Inamata, kua ora i te Pakaru Inamata, e ārai ana i te Wairua.

power.neoorigins.vampire_night_vision.de: Ka āhei te kite mārama i te pōuri katoa. Whakapā atu ki te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).

power.neoorigins.tamer_tame_mob.name: Te ārahi
power.neoorigins.tamer_tame_mob.descript: Titiro ki tētahi mano hoariri, ā, whakahohehia kia piko ai ki tō hiahia. Ka whai ia i a koe, ka tiaki hoki i a koe. E whā ngā tinihanga i whakahaeretia. E toru ngā utu o te waikura. Tekau hēkona ki muri.
